name: Google App Engine Version Statistics

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/GCP/appengine logName resource timestamp
| json "message.data.resource.type" as type 
| parse regex "\"logName\":\"(?<log_name>[^\"]+)\"" 
| where type = "gae_app" and log_name matches "projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
| parse regex "\s+\"resourceName\":\"apps/(?<project>\S+)/services/(?<service>\S+)/versions/(?<version>\S+)\""
| json "message.data.protoPayload.methodName", "message.data.severity" as method, severity

| if (method matches "*UpdateVersion", 1, 0) as updte
| if (method matches "*CreateVersion", 1, 0) as create
| if (method matches "*DeleteVersion", 1, 0) as delete
| if (severity matches "WARNING", 1, 0) as warning
| if (severity matches "ERROR", 1, 0) as error
| if (severity matches "CRITICAL", 1, 0) as critical
| if (severity matches "ALERT", 1, 0) as alert
| if (severity matches "EMERGENCY", 1, 0) as emergency

| sum(updte) as updates, sum(delete) as deletes, sum(create) as creates, sum(warning) as warnings, sum(error) as errors, sum(critical) as criticals, sum(alert) as alerts, sum(emergency) as emergencies by version, service, project
| updates+deletes+creates as total_activity
| warnings+errors+criticals+alerts+emergencies as total_severity
| fields project, service, version, total_activity, creates, updates, deletes, total_severity, emergencies, alerts, criticals, errors, warnings
| sort by total_activity

description: Gives the application lifecycle and severe message activity over the last hour on  a per app basis.
